verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents locking a customer's account to block activity during an investigation or remediation, which covers the freeze element. It also supports suspending cards and an auth-loop endpoint that lets ops accept or reject card authorizations using their own business logic, so limits can be built rather than configured. Missing for 10: native per-account and per-program transaction and velocity limit settings, holds on suspicious non-card activity (ACH/wire), a documented unlock or reinstatement path, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
